blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The provincial government of Cagayan, led by Gov. Edgar “Egay” Aglipay, has expressed its condolences to the family of 1st Lt. Angeleo Adrian Peñaflor, a native of Iguig, who was among four Philippine Air Force (PAF) personnel killed in a midair collision involving two SF-260 trainer aircraft in Batangas on Friday, Oct. 23. The two aircraft collided during a training flight at Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas. The PAF confirmed the deaths of the four pilots the following day, as an investigation into the incident continued. In a statement, the provincial government extended […]...
